d:
Long, flowing chestnut brown hair tied in a high ponytail with long, sweeping bangs framing the face. Sharp, almond-shaped amber orange eyes. Apparent age is mid-twenties with a mature, refined expression. Slender yet athletic build with a curvy silhouette. Signature outfit is a sleeveless, revealing red silk kimono with white trim, held by a wide white obi sash. Accessories include a red fabric choker and a small red ribbon tying the ponytail.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
